lines.beaver_en: Minji, is the venue layout sorted out?
lines.learner: 네, 다 정리했어요. 한번 들어 보세요.
lines.en: Yes, it's all sorted. Have a listen.
lines.roman: Ne, da jeongnihaesseoyo. Hanbeon deureo boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Where do we put the stage?
lines.learner: 무대는 시청 광장 한복판에 둘 거예요.
lines.en: The stage goes right in the middle of City Hall Plaza.
lines.roman: Mudaeneun sicheong gwangjang hanbokpane dul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is the location good? Will many people come?
lines.learner: 네, 입지가 좋아요. 각지에서 사람들이 와요.
lines.en: Yes, the location is great. People come from all over.
lines.roman: Ne, ipjiga joayo. Gakjieseo saramdeuri wayo.

lines.learner: 네, 무대 양쪽 통로를 넓게 비워 뒀어요.
lines.en: Yes, I left wide aisles on both sides of the stage.
lines.roman: Ne, mudae yangjjok tongnoreul neolge biwo dwosseoyo.

lines.en: We put signs at the entrance, at eye level.

lines.beaver: 위치와 방향에 대해 더 말해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about positions and directions?
lines.beaver_roman: Wichiwa banghyange daehae deo malhae jullaeyo?
lines.learner: 광장 가장자리에 부스를 빙 둘러 세울 거예요.
lines.en: We'll set up booths all around the edge of the plaza.
lines.roman: Gwangjang gajangjarie buseureul bing dulleo seul kkeoyeyo.

lines.learner: 풍선은 무대 위 공중에 높이 달 거예요.
lines.en: The balloons will hang high in the air above the stage.
lines.roman: Pungseoneun mudae wi gongjunge nopi dal kkeoyeyo.

lines.learner: 지하 주차장을 쓰고, 지상은 보행자 공간이에요.
lines.en: We'll use the underground parking; above ground is for pedestrians.
lines.roman: Jiha juchajangeul sseugo, jisangeun bohaengja gongganieyo.

lines.learner: 대기실은 강가 쪽 분수 옆에 있어요.
lines.en: The waiting room is next to the fountain by the riverside.
lines.roman: Daegisireun gangga jjok bunsu yeope isseoyo.

lines.learner: 내일 구석구석 한 번 더 확인할게요.
lines.en: I'll check every corner once more tomorrow.
lines.roman: Naeil guseokguseok han beon deo hwaginhalgeyo.
